title: Vast (Corvane)
description: A warm off-white page with meteorite-black text and buttons, warm-grey and moon-rock bands, one solar-orange accent, and a black frame for the footer. Instrument Sans at medium weight with tight tracking, IBM Plex Mono for small uppercase labels, 2px radius, no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling with a near-black page and warm-white text
card is the warm-grey band, muted the moon-rock band, popover the white panels; highlight is solar orange
chart-5 is pure black in both modes (the footer frame); highlight-foreground is white in both modes (text on photos)
page-gutter grows from 1rem on phones to 2.5rem; page-width 90rem gives 1360px of content at 1440
name: vastspace-theme
